notes: There are two methods of earning rewards from this event: rewards earned through accumulating Event Points, and rewards received from the Event Lottery.
The following rewards could be earned through accumulating Event Points:

rows.text: Card Sleeves: Tabletop RPG: Monster World
Game Mat: Tabletop RPG: Monster World

notes: The Card Trader EX appears during this event and remained open until one week after its conclusion. The player can trade their EX Jewels for cards, Booster Items, and Gold. Each card and Booster Item can only be obtained once from the Card Trader EX during this event, but the Gold can be obtained any number of times.
